Thanks Marissa - quick updates from security:

1) Audit logs & retention:
- We support configurable retention windows. Standard options: 90 days (default), 180 days (extended), 365 days (archive). Logs capture request metadata, routing decisions, and error traces; payload-level logging that contains PII is disabled by default and only enabled in scoped environments with customer authorization.

2) KV cache / PII handling:
- KV cache entries are TTL-based and are wiped on session expiration. We have controls to immediately purge cache entries for a customer on request. We do NOT persist PII to long-term storage in the inference runtime. For additional assurance we can provide our cache-clear audit event examples (log samples) - see Drive folder.

3) SOC 2 / pen test materials:
- SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted) - ok to share with procurement/legal under NDA.
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf - contains high-level findings and mitigation status. Full pen test report is restricted; we can provide excerpts under a mutual NDA.

4) DPA:
- The draft DPA attached is our standard template. Legal prefers negotiated redlines back in DocuSign or shared Drive.

Next steps: I will upload log-sample snippets and a short technical note about cache TTL + purge API by EOD (Fri). If Acme wants additional attestation (SOC 2 bridge letter, re-run of certain controls), that will need a lead time - let us know what level of assurance procurement needs.

-Neha
